scope: Bounded independent alternatives: specialized Pauli-proxy construction with external Stim on reconstructed f3/f5/f7, and offline Clifford-frame/tensor screen on five-round coherent d5 memory. No production changes or general recognizer.

sanitizers.scope: ASAN and UBSAN on both the baseline and unmodified external Stim; leak detection disabled because of sandbox ptrace
